description: Poročila o analizi cen električne energije gospodinjskih odjemalcev glede na izbranega dobavitelja v Sloveniji is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by MINISTRSTVO ZA OKOLJE IN PROSTOR. Poročila vsebujejo podatke o strukturi končne maloprodajne cene električne energije ter načine obračunavanja cen dobave energije posameznih dobaviteljev. Tabelarično je prikazana struktura vseh elementov mesečnega računa za elektriko za posamezne skupine odjema glede na veljavne cene konec obravnavanega leta in predhodnega leta. Coverage: MINISTRSTVO ZA OKOLJE IN PROSTOR. The publisher named on the listing is MINISTRSTVO ZA OKOLJE IN PROSTOR. Its keywords include energetika, električna energija, cena energije. The listing shows 6 download or service links in PDF, HTML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
